tr: „Your child needs a small bag, lunch, water and good shoes.“ Para öğretmene pazartesi veriliyor.
de: „Your child needs a small bag, lunch, water and good shoes.“ Das Geld gibt man der Lehrerin am Montag.

tr: Emre ilk cümlesinde "There is no sound on the left side." diyor, yani sol taraftan ses gelmiyor.
de: Im ersten Satz sagt Emre "There is no sound on the left side.", von links kommt also kein Ton.

tr: İlanda "Rent: £850 a month" yazıyor. Depozito ayrıca bir aylık kira, ama aylık kira 850 sterlin.
de: In der Anzeige steht "Rent: £850 a month". Die Kaution ist zusätzlich eine Monatsmiete, die Monatsmiete selbst sind 850 Pfund.

tr: Metinde "You must be back at the bus stop before 16:00" diyor. 13:00 serbest zamanın başlangıcı.
de: Im Text steht "You must be back at the bus stop before 16:00". 13:00 ist der Beginn der freien Zeit.

tr: Resepsiyonist "Check-in starts at two o'clock in the afternoon" diyor, yani öğleden sonra ikide.
de: "Check-in starts at two o'clock in the afternoon" sagt die Rezeption, also um zwei am Nachmittag.

tr: Soru sırası: Have + özne + üçüncü hâl + nesne; yet en sona: Have you finished your homework yet?
de: Reihenfolge der Frage: Have + Subjekt + dritte Form + Objekt; yet ganz ans Ende: Have you finished your homework yet?

tr: "It's coming at ten forty, not ten twenty." deniyor. Yani eski saat 10:20 değil, yeni saat 10:40.
de: "It's coming at ten forty, not ten twenty." heißt es. Die alte Zeit ist also nicht 10:20, die neue ist 10:40.

tr: "Tomorrow will be warmer than today — about twelve degrees." Dört derece bugünün sabah sıcaklığı.
de: "Tomorrow will be warmer than today — about twelve degrees." Vier Grad ist die Morgentemperatur von heute.

tr: İlanda "You can move in on 1 October" yazıyor. Temmuz duvarların boyandığı ay, taşınma ayı değil.
de: In der Anzeige steht "You can move in on 1 October". Im Juli wurden die Wände gestrichen, eingezogen wird dann nicht.

tr: İlanın sonunda 'Call Anna on 07700 900412 after 6 p.m.' yazıyor. Arama saati akşam 6'dan sonrası.
de: Am Ende der Anzeige steht 'Call Anna on 07700 900412 after 6 p.m.' Anrufen kann man also nach 6 Uhr abends.

tr: Son satırda "Money for the shop is on the table — twenty pounds" deniyor. Masada yirmi pound var.
de: In der letzten Zeile heißt es "Money for the shop is on the table — twenty pounds". Auf dem Tisch liegen zwanzig Pfund.

tr: Tom "On Saturday I went to my cousin's wedding in Bursa" diyor. Yani cumartesi günü düğüne gitti.
de: "On Saturday I went to my cousin's wedding in Bursa" sagt Tom. Am Samstag ging er also zur Hochzeit.

tr: Görevli "We've got Friday at half past ten" diyor ve Ayse "Friday is good for me" diye cevaplıyor.
de: "We've got Friday at half past ten" sagt die Angestellte, und Ayse antwortet "Friday is good for me".

tr: Metinde "Mum stayed at the hotel because she was tired" yazıyor. Kartpostalı yazan kişi ise Deniz.
de: Im Text steht "Mum stayed at the hotel because she was tired". Geschrieben hat die Postkarte Deniz.

tr: Second conditional: if yan cümlesinde past simple, ana cümlede would. „would“ if'ten sonra gelmez.
de: Second conditional: im if-Nebensatz past simple, im Hauptsatz would. „would“ kommt nicht hinter das if.

tr: Son satırda "Elif Demir, our new manager, will answer your questions on Saturday morning" deniyor.
de: In der letzten Zeile heißt es "Elif Demir, our new manager, will answer your questions on Saturday morning".

tr: "A one-month card is thirty euros for students" deniyor; kırk beş euro öğrenci olmayan üyeler için.
de: "A one-month card is thirty euros for students" heißt es; fünfundvierzig Euro gelten für Mitglieder ohne Studium.

tr: „For children and students they are four euros.“ Yedi euro normal fiyat, beş euro pazartesi fiyatı.
de: „For children and students they are four euros.“ Sieben Euro ist der normale Preis, fünf Euro der Montagspreis.

tr: Davetiyede "Ceremony: 4:00 p.m." yazıyor; saat üç buçuk fotoğraf saati, altı buçuk ise yemek saati.
de: In der Einladung steht "Ceremony: 4:00 p.m."; halb vier ist die Fotozeit, halb sieben die Essenszeit.

tr: Deniz "For three years. I started in a small hotel in Izmir" diyor, yani üç yıldır aşçılık yapıyor.
de: "For three years. I started in a small hotel in Izmir" sagt Deniz, kocht also seit drei Jahren.

tr: Emre "I'd like a cheese sandwich and a small coffee, please." diyor; yani peynirli sandviç istiyor.
de: "I'd like a cheese sandwich and a small coffee, please." sagt Emre; er möchte also ein Käsesandwich.

tr: "Call me back tonight" diyor. Taksiyi zaten kendisi ayırtmış: "I have already booked a taxi for us."
de: "Call me back tonight" sagt sie. Das Taxi hat sie schon selbst bestellt: "I have already booked a taxi for us."

tr: Doktor 'Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.' diyor; günde üç kez birer hap, yani üç hap.
de: 'Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.' sagt die Ärztin; dreimal am Tag je eine, also drei Tabletten.

tr: Hemşire "I used to drive to work. Now I walk" diyor, yani eskiden araba kullanıyordu, şimdi yürüyor.
de: "I used to drive to work. Now I walk" sagt die Pflegekraft, fuhr also früher mit dem Auto und geht heute zu Fuß.

tr: İlk cümle „class 3B goes to the city zoo“ — sınıf geziye gidiyor; öğretmen ya da parti anlatılmıyor.
de: Der erste Satz lautet „class 3B goes to the city zoo“ — die Klasse macht einen Ausflug; von Lehrkraft oder Party ist keine Rede.

tr: Kartta "Time: 9:30 in the morning" yazıyor. 8 ve 6 ise sağlık merkezinin açılış ve kapanış saatleri.
de: Auf der Karte steht "Time: 9:30 in the morning". 8 und 6 sind die Öffnungs- und Schließzeiten des Gesundheitszentrums.

tr: Konuşmanın sonunda "See you on Friday at half past ten" deniyor. On iki, Ayse'nin işten çıkış saati.
de: Am Ende des Gesprächs heißt es "See you on Friday at half past ten". Zwölf ist Ayses Feierabend.

tr: „Is there a name in the bag?“ — „No, but … my name is on the library card.“ Ad kartta, çantada değil.
de: „Is there a name in the bag?“ — „No, but … my name is on the library card.“ Der Name steht auf der Karte, nicht in der Tasche.

tr: Davetiyenin alt kısmında "Please answer before 20 August" yazıyor; 12 Eylül ise düğünün kendi tarihi.
de: Unten in der Einladung steht "Please answer before 20 August"; der 12. September ist das Datum der Hochzeit selbst.

tr: Görevli "It's forty dollars. The green one is thirty dollars." diyor; kırk dolar siyah olanın fiyatı.
de: "It's forty dollars. The green one is thirty dollars." sagt die Angestellte; vierzig Dollar kostet die schwarze.

tr: Metnin tamamı yazarın kendi yüzme hikâyesi; kızı ve plaj yalnız başlangıç noktası (ilk iki paragraf).
de: Der ganze Text ist die eigene Schwimmgeschichte der Autorin; Tochter und Strand sind nur der Ausgangspunkt (die ersten zwei Absätze).

tr: "I took forty photos" cümlesine göre kırk fotoğraf çekti. Üç saat yürüdükleri de aynı cümlede yazıyor.
de: Nach dem Satz "I took forty photos" hat sie vierzig Fotos gemacht. Dass sie drei Stunden liefen, steht im selben Satz.

tr: Deniz notunda "I used to work in a small pizza place in Izmir, and I made coffee every morning" diyor.
de: In seiner Notiz sagt Deniz "I used to work in a small pizza place in Izmir, and I made coffee every morning".

tr: Kayıtta "A new passport photo costs twelve euros" geçiyor; ayrıca nakit ödenmesi gerektiği söyleniyor.
de: In der Ansage kommt "A new passport photo costs twelve euros" vor; außerdem heißt es, dass bar zu zahlen ist.

tr: Kurallar bölümünde "Small pets are fine, but dogs are not" yazıyor. Küçük hayvanlar olur, köpek olmaz.
de: Im Abschnitt mit den Regeln steht "Small pets are fine, but dogs are not". Kleine Tiere gehen, Hunde nicht.

tr: Mert "I'm going to meet Deniz there on Saturday at eleven o'clock." diyor, yani buluşma saat on birde.
de: "I'm going to meet Deniz there on Saturday at eleven o'clock." sagt Mert, das Treffen ist also um elf.

tr: Metinde "Check-out: Monday, 15 June, before 11:00" yazıyor, yani odadan saat 11:00'den önce çıkılmalı.
de: Im Text steht "Check-out: Monday, 15 June, before 11:00", das Zimmer ist also vor 11:00 zu räumen.

tr: Deniz konuşmanın başında 'My laptop doesn't connect to the internet.' diyor. Sorun internet bağlantısı.
de: Am Anfang des Gesprächs sagt Deniz 'My laptop doesn't connect to the internet.' Das Problem ist die Internetverbindung.

tr: Kartta "Bring this card and your ID." yazıyor. Su içmek ilaç notuyla ilgili, getirilecek bir şey değil.
de: Auf der Karte steht "Bring this card and your ID." Wasser zu trinken gehört zur Medikamentennotiz, nicht zum Mitbringen.

tr: Ms. Clark "The shift starts at seven thirty in the morning" diyor; vardiya sabah yedi buçukta başlıyor.
de: "The shift starts at seven thirty in the morning" sagt Ms. Clark; die Schicht beginnt also um halb acht früh.

tr: „Nobody wants surprises on holiday.“ — nobody olumsuz anlam taşır ama fiil olumlu ve tekil kalır: wants.
de: „Nobody wants surprises on holiday.“ — nobody trägt die Verneinung, das Verb bleibt aber bejaht und einzahlig: wants.

tr: "the new departure time is 3:35" cümlesinden anlaşılıyor. 3:15 eski saat, 5:40 ise sonraki trenin saati.
de: Aus "the new departure time is 3:35" geht es hervor. 3:15 ist die alte Zeit, 5:40 die des nächsten Zuges.

tr: Emma sarı portu soruyor, Deniz bakıp 'No, it's in the grey one.' diyor. Kablo yanlışlıkla gri porttaydı.
de: Emma fragt nach dem gelben Port, Deniz schaut nach und sagt 'No, it's in the grey one.' Das Kabel steckte im grauen Port.

tr: Kayıtta "From Monday to Friday, we open at six in the morning" deniyor; yani hafta içi açılış saat altı.
de: In der Ansage heißt es "From Monday to Friday, we open at six in the morning"; unter der Woche wird also um sechs geöffnet.

tr: Listede "Shoes: black or brown. 45 dollars." satırı var. 12 dolar tişörtlerin, 30 dolar kotların fiyatı.
de: In der Liste steht die Zeile "Shoes: black or brown. 45 dollars." 12 Dollar kosten die T-Shirts, 30 Dollar die Jeans.

tr: Kaan "That's my aunt Julia. She's my mother's sister." diyor. Julia, annesinin kız kardeşi, yani teyzesi.
de: "That's my aunt Julia. She's my mother's sister." sagt Kaan. Julia ist die Schwester seiner Mutter, also seine Tante.

tr: Kayıt "Yoga classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at seven" diyor; yoga salı ve perşembe akşamları.
de: Die Ansage sagt "Yoga classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at seven"; Yoga ist also Dienstag- und Donnerstagabend.

tr: Leyla ev takasını anlatıyor: „you just swap keys“, „No rent, no.“ Para kazanmak ya da fotoğraf satmak yok.
de: Leyla erzählt vom Haustausch: „you just swap keys“, „No rent, no.“ Von Geldverdienen oder Fotoverkauf ist keine Rede.

tr: Programda 2. gün (Cumartesi) 09:30'da "Bus to the castle" yazıyor, yani kaleye Cumartesi sabahı gidiliyor.
de: Im Programm steht an Tag 2 (Samstag) um 09:30 "Bus to the castle", zur Burg geht es also am Samstagmorgen.

tr: "Next week he will open a small office in Istanbul" diyor; gelecek hafta İstanbul'da küçük bir ofis açacak.
de: "Next week he will open a small office in Istanbul" heißt es; nächste Woche eröffnet er in Istanbul ein kleines Büro.

tr: Duyuruda "Swimming for beginners - Saturday, 11 a.m." yazıyor. Pazar günü ders değil, arkadaş getirme günü.
de: Im Aushang steht "Swimming for beginners - Saturday, 11 a.m." Der Sonntag ist kein Kurstag, sondern der Tag zum Mitbringen von Freunden.

tr: Not şöyle: "We have not got Wi-Fi in the garden, but there is Wi-Fi inside." Yani Wi-Fi sadece içeride var.
de: Die Notiz lautet: "We have not got Wi-Fi in the garden, but there is Wi-Fi inside." WLAN gibt es also nur drinnen.

tr: Yanlış. Ankara'ya "to study engineering" yani mühendislik okumak için gitti; tasarımı ona öğretmeni önerdi.
de: Falsch. Nach Ankara ging sie "to study engineering", also um Ingenieurwesen zu studieren; das Design empfahl ihr die Lehrerin.

tr: "There are 200 new dresses... They are yellow, green and pink." Kırmızı, mavi ve beyaz tişörtlerin renkleri.
de: "There are 200 new dresses... They are yellow, green and pink." Rot, blau und weiß sind die Farben der T-Shirts.

tr: Anonsta "It's going to leave from platform 9. Please walk to platform 9 now." deniyor. Peron 4 eski perondu.
de: In der Durchsage heißt es "It's going to leave from platform 9. Please walk to platform 9 now." Gleis 4 war das alte Gleis.

tr: "The tickets are only twenty lira for students." cümlesinden öğrenci biletinin yirmi lira olduğu anlaşılıyor.
de: Aus dem Satz "The tickets are only twenty lira for students." geht hervor, dass die Studierendenkarte zwanzig Lira kostet.

tr: Park yeri sorulunca resepsiyonist "Yes, but it costs 5 euros a day" diyor. 60 euro odanın bir gecelik fiyatı.
de: Auf die Frage nach dem Parkplatz sagt die Rezeption "Yes, but it costs 5 euros a day". 60 Euro ist der Zimmerpreis pro Nacht.

tr: Sunucu "he made an app for people who always lose their keys" diyor; uygulama anahtarlarını kaybedenler için.
de: "he made an app for people who always lose their keys" sagt der Moderator; die App ist für Leute, die ihre Schlüssel verlieren.

tr: Yanlış. Resepsiyonist "It's 60 euros a night, and the price includes breakfast" diyor; kahvaltı fiyata dahil.
de: Falsch. "It's 60 euros a night, and the price includes breakfast" sagt die Rezeption; das Frühstück ist also im Preis.

tr: 3. günde "Last year it rained all morning and everybody was cold" yazıyor; bu yüzden sıcak bir mont isteniyor.
de: An Tag 3 steht "Last year it rained all morning and everybody was cold"; darum wird eine warme Jacke verlangt.

tr: İlanda 'The flat is on Green Street, near the train station.' yazıyor. Yani daire tren istasyonunun yakınında.
de: In der Anzeige steht 'The flat is on Green Street, near the train station.' Die Wohnung liegt also nahe am Bahnhof.

tr: Metin "We exchange them, but we never give money back for them" diyor. İndirimli ürünlerde sadece değişim var.
de: Der Text sagt "We exchange them, but we never give money back for them". Bei reduzierter Ware gibt es nur Umtausch.

tr: Rocky her şeyden korkuyordu; otobüs durduğunda kaçmadı. Yazar bunu „better than any thank-you“ diye anlatıyor.
de: Rocky hatte vor allem Angst; als der Bus hielt, lief er nicht weg. Die Autorin nennt das „better than any thank-you“.

tr: „It is not a rule with a punishment. Nobody takes your phone away.“ — telefon içeri girebiliyor, kullanılmıyor.
de: „It is not a rule with a punishment. Nobody takes your phone away.“ — das Telefon darf hinein, es wird nur nicht benutzt.

tr: „Two weeks I can live with.“ — Ana'nın koşullu önerisini kabul ediyor, yalnız Dilara'ya bugün konuşmak istiyor.
de: „Two weeks I can live with.“ — er nimmt Anas bedingten Vorschlag an, will aber heute noch mit Dilara sprechen.

tr: Duyuruda "We are open every day, from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m." yazıyor. Yani kulüp 7'de açılıyor, 22.00'de kapanıyor.
de: Im Aushang steht "We are open every day, from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m." Der Club öffnet also um 7 und schließt um 22.00.

tr: Metinde "There is no lift, so you must use the stairs" deniyor. Yani asansör yok, merdiven kullanmak gerekiyor.
de: Im Text heißt es "There is no lift, so you must use the stairs". Es gibt also keinen Aufzug, man muss die Treppe nehmen.

tr: Doktor "How long have you had this headache?" diye soruyor, hasta "Since Monday. So about four days now." diyor.
de: Die Ärztin fragt "How long have you had this headache?" und bekommt zur Antwort "Since Monday. So about four days now.", also seit Montag.

tr: Emma 'Have you restarted the router already?' diye soruyor, Deniz 'Yes, twice.' yani iki kez diye cevap veriyor.
de: Emma fragt 'Have you restarted the router already?' und Deniz antwortet 'Yes, twice.', also zweimal.

tr: Emma "on Sunday I went to the new bookshop near the station" diyor. Cumartesi evde kaldı, pazar kitapçıya gitti.
de: "on Sunday I went to the new bookshop near the station" sagt Emma. Am Samstag blieb sie zu Hause, am Sonntag ging sie zum Buchladen.

tr: Müşteri "Have you got it in black? Blue isn't my color." diyor ve sonunda "The black one, please." diye seçiyor.
de: Die Kundin sagt "Have you got it in black? Blue isn't my color." und wählt am Ende mit "The black one, please." die schwarze.

tr: „Written comments still work, because they cannot be averaged.“ Tek bir cümle üç yüz yıldızdan fazlasını taşıyor.
de: „Written comments still work, because they cannot be averaged.“ Ein einziger Satz trägt mehr als dreihundert Sterne.

tr: Kayıtta "On Saturday we are open until twelve o'clock." deniyor, yani ofisler cumartesi saat on ikiye kadar açık.
de: In der Ansage heißt es "On Saturday we are open until twelve o'clock.", die Ämter sind am Samstag also bis zwölf offen.

tr: Mesajda "we're buying one big present together. Everybody is giving four hundred lira" deniyor, yani bilgi doğru.
de: In der Nachricht heißt es "we're buying one big present together. Everybody is giving four hundred lira", die Angabe stimmt also.

tr: Notun başında "I am at work until six o'clock" yazıyor. Yedi dükkânın kapanma saati, sekiz de Tom'un geliş saati.
de: Oben in der Notiz steht "I am at work until six o'clock". Sieben ist die Schließzeit des Ladens, acht die Ankunftszeit von Tom.

tr: "After school I go to the library with Deniz. We do our homework there until five." Elif kahvaltıdaki kız kardeşi.
de: "After school I go to the library with Deniz. We do our homework there until five." Elif ist die Schwester beim Frühstück.

tr: Başlık ve ilk cümle bunu söylüyor: dört hafta önce gönüllü olarak başladı. Kapanma ya da köpek seçme hiç geçmiyor.
de: Überschrift und erster Satz sagen es: vor vier Wochen fing sie ehrenamtlich an. Von Schließung oder Hundeauswahl ist nirgends die Rede.

tr: "On Sundays it closes earlier, at 17:00" cümlesi pazar günü kapanışı 17:00 olarak veriyor; 19:00 diğer günler için.
de: Der Satz "On Sundays it closes earlier, at 17:00" nennt den Sonntagsschluss mit 17:00; 19:00 gilt für die anderen Tage.

tr: "There's a big queue on Bridge Road, because workers are fixing the road" cümlesinden anlıyoruz: yolda çalışma var.
de: Aus "There's a big queue on Bridge Road, because workers are fixing the road" wissen wir es: an der Straße wird gearbeitet.

tr: İlanın sonunda "leave a note in the blue box near the door" deniyor; not kapının yanındaki mavi kutuya bırakılıyor.
de: Am Ende der Anzeige heißt es "leave a note in the blue box near the door"; die Notiz kommt in den blauen Kasten neben der Tür.

tr: since + başlangıç noktası, durum sürüyor → present perfect: has lived. Türkçedeki „yaşıyor“ seni „lives“e çekmesin.
de: since + Anfangspunkt und der Zustand dauert an → present perfect: has lived. Unser „wohnt“ soll dich nicht zu „lives“ ziehen.

tr: „If the code cannot be read, the bag is sent to a small room where a person reads it by hand.“ — yalnız üç yüzde bir.
de: „If the code cannot be read, the bag is sent to a small room where a person reads it by hand.“ — nur eines von dreihundert.

tr: „Marta, who has worked there for nine years, showed me everything.“ — deneyimli çalışan, komşu ya da ziyaretçi değil.
de: „Marta, who has worked there for nine years, showed me everything.“ — eine erfahrene Mitarbeiterin, keine Nachbarin und kein Gast.

tr: "Saturday is sunny, but Sunday is rainy, so Saturday is better." cümlesinde pazar gününün yağmurlu olduğu söyleniyor.
de: Im Satz "Saturday is sunny, but Sunday is rainy, so Saturday is better." heißt es, dass der Sonntag regnerisch ist.

tr: Ms. Clark "Have you ever worked in a big kitchen?" diye soruyor, Deniz "No, I haven't." diye cevaplıyor. Yani yanlış.
de: Ms. Clark fragt "Have you ever worked in a big kitchen?" und Deniz antwortet "No, I haven't." Es stimmt also nicht.

tr: „On a street with traffic it disappeared completely. Beautiful and useless.“ — eksiltili cümle yargıyı sertleştiriyor.
de: „On a street with traffic it disappeared completely. Beautiful and useless.“ — der Ellipsensatz macht das Urteil härter.

tr: "September evenings are colder than you think, and the dinner is outside" cümlesi ceket getirmesinin sebebini veriyor.
de: Der Satz "September evenings are colder than you think, and the dinner is outside" nennt den Grund für die Jacke.

tr: „Those are different sentences, and one of them we can keep.“ — söz verilebilecek olanla verilemeyecek olanı ayırıyor.
de: „Those are different sentences, and one of them we can keep.“ — es trennt, was versprochen werden kann, von dem, was nicht.

tr: Broşürde "Free classes every Tuesday at 6 p.m. in Room 4" yazıyor. Cumartesi 10.00 ise sadece yemek atölyesinin saati.
de: In der Broschüre steht "Free classes every Tuesday at 6 p.m. in Room 4". Samstag 10.00 ist nur die Zeit der Kochwerkstatt.

tr: Yanlış. "The train is also twenty minutes late, so the new departure time is 3:35" diyor; tren yirmi dakika gecikmeli.
de: Falsch. "The train is also twenty minutes late, so the new departure time is 3:35" heißt es; der Zug hat zwanzig Minuten Verspätung.

tr: „Before our first exchange, I hid all our photos and locked one room.“ Pasta ve temiz ev, döndüklerinde buldukları şey.
de: „Before our first exchange, I hid all our photos and locked one room.“ Kuchen und sauberes Haus fanden sie bei der Rückkehr.

tr: „The work is not romantic. I clean cages, I wash blankets and I carry heavy bags.“ — iş ağır, güzel olan başka bir şey.
de: „The work is not romantic. I clean cages, I wash blankets and I carry heavy bags.“ — die Arbeit ist schwer, das Schöne liegt woanders.

tr: Emma "the tall man with glasses" diye soruyor, Kaan da "He's very tall, and he's got a big beard now." diye cevaplıyor.
de: Emma fragt nach "the tall man with glasses" und Kaan antwortet darauf "He's very tall, and he's got a big beard now.".

tr: Mert otelde kalmayacaklarını söylüyor: "my cousin has a flat near the sea. We're going to stay there for three nights."
de: Mert sagt, dass sie nicht im Hotel bleiben: "my cousin has a flat near the sea. We're going to stay there for three nights."

tr: Metin "you must tell us your car number when you arrive" diyor; otopark ücretsiz ama araç plakasını söylemek gerekiyor.
de: Der Text sagt "you must tell us your car number when you arrive"; der Parkplatz ist frei, aber das Kennzeichen ist zu nennen.

tr: Deniz yorumunda "I used to study with music, but I could never finish anything" diyor. Yani eskiden müzikle çalışıyordu.
de: In seinem Kommentar sagt Deniz "I used to study with music, but I could never finish anything". Früher lernte er also mit Musik.

tr: Saldırgan yorumların önemli bir bölümü zaten gerçek adla yazılmışsa, gerçek ad zorunluluğu sorunu hedeflemiyor demektir.
de: Ist ein guter Teil der beleidigenden Kommentare ohnehin unter echtem Namen geschrieben, trifft die Klarnamenpflicht das Problem nicht.

tr: „He wrote us a long apology … my own children have broken more.“ — özür ve karşılaştırma, olayı küçümsediğini gösteriyor.
de: „He wrote us a long apology … my own children have broken more.“ — Entschuldigung und Vergleich zeigen, dass sie es kleinredet.

tr: „Marta didn't laugh. She told us that fear is normal …“ — yazar öğretmenin anlayışını vurguluyor; sertlik ya da şaka yok.
de: „Marta didn't laugh. She told us that fear is normal …“ — die Autorin hebt das Verständnis der Lehrerin hervor; nichts Hartes, kein Scherz.

tr: Emma 'Only home visits cost money. They're 30 pounds.' diyor. Ücretsiz olan telefon görüşmesi; 419 ise referans numarası.
de: 'Only home visits cost money. They're 30 pounds.' sagt Emma. Kostenlos ist das Telefonat; 419 ist die Aktennummer.

tr: „she asked me why I never came into the water … I didn't have a good answer.“ Öğretmenin sözü ve tatil daha sonra geliyor.
de: „she asked me why I never came into the water … I didn't have a good answer.“ Das Wort der Lehrerin und der Urlaub kommen später.

tr: Garson "Do you want milk in your coffee?" diye soruyor, Emre "No, thanks. I don't like milk." diyor. Yani sütlü istemiyor.
de: Der Kellner fragt "Do you want milk in your coffee?" und Emre sagt "No, thanks. I don't like milk." Er will ihn also ohne Milch.

tr: Metinde "We arrived on Friday evening" yazıyor, yani cuma akşamı vardılar. Cumartesi plaja gittiler, ama varış günü değil.
de: Im Text steht "We arrived on Friday evening", sie kamen also am Freitagabend an. Am Samstag gingen sie an den Strand, das war nicht der Ankunftstag.

tr: Spiker başta "It's eight o'clock" diyor. Saat dokuz ise bir sonraki bültenin saati: "I'll be back with more news at nine."
de: Der Sprecher sagt am Anfang "It's eight o'clock". Neun Uhr ist die Zeit der nächsten Meldung: "I'll be back with more news at nine."

tr: Third conditional geçmişi tersine çevirir: past perfect + would have + past participle. Diğerleri birinci ve ikinci koşul.
de: Der third conditional dreht die Vergangenheit um: past perfect + would have + past participle. Die anderen sind erste und zweite Bedingung.

tr: „A rule can be challenged, published, voted on, reversed. A shape cannot.“ — itiraz edilebilirlik farkı yazının merkezinde.
de: „A rule can be challenged, published, voted on, reversed. A shape cannot.“ — die Anfechtbarkeit steht im Zentrum des Textes.

tr: Notta "I have already booked a room for you at the hotel" diyor ve parasını ödememesini, bunun hediyeleri olduğunu ekliyor.
de: In der Notiz steht "I have already booked a room for you at the hotel", und sie fügt hinzu, dass Marta nichts zahlen soll, es sei ihr Geschenk.

tr: On üzerinden ondan azını şikâyet sayan bir sistemde misafirden şirketin hedefini tutturması isteniyor; cümle bunun ironisi.
de: In einem System, das weniger als zehn von zehn als Beschwerde zählt, soll der Gast die Zielmarke der Firma erfüllen; der Satz ist die Ironie darauf.

tr: "We've got a big sale on bread too — buy two, get one free." cümlesi iki ekmek alana bir tanesinin bedava olduğunu söylüyor.
de: Der Satz "We've got a big sale on bread too — buy two, get one free." sagt, dass man bei zwei Broten eines geschenkt bekommt.

tr: „Some people do use them exactly that way. It is simply not the reason the bench was redesigned.“ — doğru, ama gerekçe değil.
de: „Some people do use them exactly that way. It is simply not the reason the bench was redesigned.“ — stimmt, ist aber nicht der Grund.

tr: "It's at the Green Garden Hotel, near the train station" cümlesinden yer anlaşılıyor; havaalanı değil, tren istasyonunun yanı.
de: Aus "It's at the Green Garden Hotel, near the train station" geht der Ort hervor; nicht der Flughafen, sondern neben dem Bahnhof.

tr: "On Saturday, we're open from eight to eight" cümlesi sabah sekizden akşam sekize kadar açık olduklarını söylüyor, yani doğru.
de: Der Satz "On Saturday, we're open from eight to eight" sagt, dass von acht Uhr früh bis acht Uhr abends offen ist, es stimmt also.

tr: „You asked in a meeting, with you in the room. That is not the same as an open call.“ — soru soruluş biçimi cevabı belirliyor.
de: „You asked in a meeting, with you in the room. That is not the same as an open call.“ — wie gefragt wird, bestimmt die Antwort.

tr: "For a birth certificate or proof of address, please come to the third floor, room 214." deniyor: üçüncü kat, 214 numaralı oda.
de: "For a birth certificate or proof of address, please come to the third floor, room 214." heißt es: dritter Stock, Zimmer 214.

tr: „If you had told us …“ karşı tarafa yönelince suçlama gibi okunur; bu yüzden kurumsal yazıda özneyi kendine çevirmek yaygındır.
de: Auf das Gegenüber gerichtet liest sich „If you had told us …“ wie ein Vorwurf; darum wendet man das Subjekt im Geschäftsschreiben oft auf sich selbst.

tr: "You must bring your ID card and your last bill when you pay for water" cümlesi bunu söylüyor. Ayrıca nakit artık kabul edilmiyor.
de: Der Satz "You must bring your ID card and your last bill when you pay for water" sagt es. Bargeld wird außerdem nicht mehr angenommen.

tr: Notta "Breakfast is only in the morning. We serve it from 8:00 to 11:00." diyor. Kafe 19:00'a kadar açık ama kahvaltı sadece sabah.
de: In der Notiz heißt es "Breakfast is only in the morning. We serve it from 8:00 to 11:00." Das Café ist bis 19:00 offen, das Frühstück aber nur morgens.

tr: Tam tersi: „staff … are not the villains of this story; they have been handed a social problem in the form of a cleaning schedule.“
de: Genau umgekehrt: „staff … are not the villains of this story; they have been handed a social problem in the form of a cleaning schedule.“

tr: Ölçüt dilsel: gerekçe nesnenin yanındaki bir levhaya tek düz cümleyle yazılamıyorsa, tasarım söylenmek istenmeyen bir iş yapıyordur.
de: Das Kriterium ist sprachlich: lässt sich der Grund nicht in einem geraden Satz auf ein Schild neben der Sache schreiben, tut die Gestaltung etwas Unaussprechliches.

tr: "Our offices are open from Monday to Friday, from eight thirty in the morning" cümlesi açılış saatinin sekiz buçuk olduğunu söylüyor.
de: Der Satz "Our offices are open from Monday to Friday, from eight thirty in the morning" nennt halb neun als Öffnungszeit.

tr: Anonsta "The train to Manchester is leaving from platform five at nine fifteen." deniyor. Manchester treni beşinci perondan kalkıyor.
de: In der Durchsage heißt es "The train to Manchester is leaving from platform five at nine fifteen." Der Manchester-Zug fährt von Gleis fünf.

tr: Metinde "More than three hundred people came to the small park next to the river at nine o'clock" yazıyor, yani saat dokuzda geldiler.
de: Im Text steht "More than three hundred people came to the small park next to the river at nine o'clock", sie kamen also um neun.

tr: „improved seating“ gibi bir ifade kararı ve karar vereni görünmez kılıyor; „Nobody has to defend a policy that was never written down.“
de: Eine Wendung wie „improved seating“ macht die Entscheidung und die Entscheidenden unsichtbar; „Nobody has to defend a policy that was never written down.“

tr: "We have already received your deposit of £60" cümlesine göre otel şimdiye kadar 60 sterlin kapora almış; 240 sterlin ise toplam fiyat.
de: Nach dem Satz "We have already received your deposit of £60" hat das Hotel bisher 60 Pfund Anzahlung bekommen; 240 Pfund ist der Gesamtpreis.

tr: Son bölümde "The council will plant fifty new trees along the river path next spring" deniyor; gelecek bahar elli yeni ağaç dikecekler.
de: Im letzten Abschnitt heißt es "The council will plant fifty new trees along the river path next spring"; im nächsten Frühjahr werden fünfzig neue Bäume gepflanzt.

tr: „a low score can cost someone their work, so they give five stars to anyone who was not rude“ — puan bir değerlendirme değil, bir karar.
de: „a low score can cost someone their work, so they give five stars to anyone who was not rude“ — die Punktzahl ist keine Bewertung, sondern eine Entscheidung.

tr: "Passengers for Liverpool can wait in the café next to platform three." cümlesinden anlıyoruz; kafe üç numaralı peronun yanında ve açık.
de: Aus "Passengers for Liverpool can wait in the café next to platform three." wissen wir es; das Café liegt neben Gleis drei und ist offen.

tr: Ana da Dilara'yı beğeniyor; tartışma süreç üzerine: „I would like to see an external shortlist as well, even if we end up choosing her.“
de: Auch Ana schätzt Dilara; der Streit geht ums Verfahren: „I would like to see an external shortlist as well, even if we end up choosing her.“

tr: "the store is closing at eight o'clock this evening" cümlesi kapanış saatinin sekiz olduğunu söylüyor; saat üç ise duyurunun yapıldığı saat.
de: Der Satz "the store is closing at eight o'clock this evening" nennt acht als Schließzeit; drei Uhr ist die Zeit der Durchsage.

tr: „If we teach a generation that quiet means dangerous and loud means safe, we will have solved this decade's problem and created the next one.“
de: „If we teach a generation that quiet means dangerous and loud means safe, we will have solved this decade's problem and created the next one.“

tr: Yazı boyunca ölçeğin ikiye indiği, örneklemin bozuk olduğu ve baskının eklendiği anlatılıyor; son paragraf geri bildirimin kendisini savunuyor.
de: Der ganze Text erzählt, dass die Skala auf zwei geschrumpft ist, die Stichprobe verzerrt und Druck dazugekommen ist; der letzte Absatz verteidigt die Rückmeldung selbst.

tr: „What we test for is whether a listener can tell … that the car is approaching … Not whether they like it.“ Beğeni sonradan ve tekrardan geliyor.
de: „What we test for is whether a listener can tell … that the car is approaching … Not whether they like it.“ Das Gefallen kommt später und aus der Wiederholung.

tr: Yanlış. Mert "I've got a big bag with sandwiches, so don't bring food." diyor; yemeği kendisi getiriyor, ondan sadece fotoğraf makinesini istiyor.
de: Falsch. "I've got a big bag with sandwiches, so don't bring food." sagt Mert; das Essen bringt er selbst mit, von ihr will er nur den Fotoapparat.

tr: Elif "Have you finished your report yet?" diye soruyor, Kerem ise "Not yet! I must start tonight." diye cevap veriyor. Yani raporu henüz bitirmedi.
de: Elif fragt "Have you finished your report yet?" und Kerem antwortet "Not yet! I must start tonight." Den Bericht hat er also noch nicht fertig.

tr: Yazıda "Please give us your email address before 25 March" deniyor. 1 Nisan e-posta faturalarının başlayacağı tarih, 12 Mart ise yazının tarihidir.
de: Im Text heißt es "Please give us your email address before 25 March". Der 1. April ist der Beginn der Mailrechnungen, der 12. März das Datum des Schreibens.

tr: Beşinci paragraf bunu açıkça ayırıyor: „What I object to is not that a choice was made. It is that the choice was made silently, and then furnished.“
de: Der fünfte Absatz trennt es deutlich: „What I object to is not that a choice was made. It is that the choice was made silently, and then furnished.“

tr: Yazıda "Since Monday we have worked at 4 King Street, next to the library" diyor. Ofis kütüphanenin içinde değil, yanındadır; Mill Road'daki eski ofis kapandı.
de: Im Text steht "Since Monday we have worked at 4 King Street, next to the library". Das Amt ist nicht in der Bibliothek, sondern daneben; das alte Büro an der Mill Road ist zu.

tr: Haber şöyle diyor: "The bridge closed last November because heavy rain damaged the stone under it." Sebep şiddetli yağmurun köprünün altındaki taşa zarar vermesi.
de: Die Meldung sagt so: "The bridge closed last November because heavy rain damaged the stone under it." Grund ist der Schaden, den starker Regen am Stein darunter anrichtete.

tr: "You must call before you come, because the classes are small" cümlesi telefon etmeyi zorunlu kılıyor. Havlu sadece yoga için, 300 ise bu yıl yardım edilen kişi sayısı.
de: Der Satz "You must call before you come, because the classes are small" macht den Anruf zur Pflicht. Das Handtuch gilt nur fürs Yoga, 300 ist die Zahl der in diesem Jahr Unterstützten.
